## 更新内容 / Changes

补充此版本已实现的功能和修复。 / Describe the features and fixes included in this version.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。升级前退出应用，再安装新版；账号、实例与本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Quit the app before installing an update; accounts, instances and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

当前支持 Codex，客户端需单独安装。Claude Code 与 Claude Desktop（Chat / Cowork / Code）为计划功能，尚未接入。桌面菜单和语言适配取决于 Codex 版本，Fast 还取决于模型和服务商能力。

Codex is currently supported and must be installed separately. Claude Code and Claude Desktop (Chat / Cowork / Code) are planned, not implemented. Desktop menu and language integration depend on the Codex version; Fast also depends on the model and provider.
